A.text: Each coulomb of charge from the battery supplies $9.0\,\text{J}$ of electrical energy to the whole circuit.

B.text: The battery supplies $9.0\,\text{J}$ of electrical energy to an external circuit for each coulomb of charge.

C.text: The potential difference across any component connected to the battery will be $9.0\,\text{V}$.

D.text: There will always be a potential difference of $9.0\,\text{V}$ across the battery terminals.
